claim: Voiced fillers (hmm, haha) reach TTS instead of being deleted, so the reply keeps its beat of thought.

listen_check.instructions: Play before.wav then after.wav for the A/B. Then play each per-filler sample and decide whether any of umm/uhh/ahh/mmm/heh should be promoted to the voiced tier, or whether hmm/haha should be demoted. Record the verdict and listener here.

tier_probe.method: each filler synthesized alone as '<filler>.' through the same Kokoro pack
tier_probe.conclusion: Duration and loudness DO NOT discriminate the tiers. Every filler produced 0.58-0.80s at -22 to -24 dBFS; none is silent and none is spelled out letter by letter. The tier split is a product decision pending a listen check, not a measured result -- do not cite these numbers as justification for it.
